name: Hypercubes Are Strictly Simplex Graphs
scope: Finite simple connected graphs under the survey conventions.
statement: Every hypercube is a simplex graph, and the containment is strict.
proof: The hypercube $Q_n$ is the simplex graph of the edgeless $n$-vertex graph. The star $K_{1,3}$ is a simplex graph but is not a hypercube.
